body:
## Result and scope

Refs #319

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/319#issuecomment-6867467884, session `ADB991-claude-20261113-5d52`.
- Unit IDs or other outputs: YM-000026. Changes: a new subsection `sec:selected-zero-coordinate-coupon` with `prop:selected-zero-coordinate-coupon` in `manuscript/existence/selected-centered-service.tex`, and an author note `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C12/author/ADB991-claude-20261113-5d52/README.md`.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

**What changed.** This is the C12 export of item (R7): the zero-coordinate Coupon on the stored doors, for t_d ≤ i < N.
- **Proved:**
  - the tuning inequality (1+2C_i)·rate(L_i) ≤ barunit(L_i), with η_i = rate(L_i) = L_i^{-2/5}. The proof uses the grade-zero threshold v_j, which is a block floor of every stage k ≥ j, and the fact that L_i is chosen at stage J(i+1) ≥ J(i);
  - ψ_i ≥ 0 and η_i > 0;
  - finiteness of the wing, independently of Q;
  - repacking of the forced array onto Keeper addresses. This preserves the exponential entry, forced profile, density (the dressed field depends only on the tag), format and remainder bound;
  - the decomposition of a zero-coordinate Q into regular and forced insertions, with the price accounting Σ ≤ (ηq, ηq, 2q).
- **Reduced to three stated inputs on the same stored door:**
  - (K) the regular and forced single-insertion estimates of `sec:three-port-history`;
  - (S) soundness;
  - (M) the countable Coupon merger. It is outstanding in `ex-selected-linear-interpolation`; in Lean it is `coupons`/`Coupon.weaken`/`zeroSlot`.
- The (R7) sentence in "Relation to the paid selected-history record" now points to the proposition. As review #328 N9 asked, it no longer implies that the proof of `prop:ex-original-history-attachment` derives (R7).
- It also separates the R7 rate η_i = L_i^{-2/5} from the marker price η_m = ¼β̂_m^{-1/2} used earlier in the chapter (review #328 O2).

**Uncertain.**
- Q1: the two admissibility facts used in the dressed-field step are read from Lean (`reach`, `tariff`), not from a manuscript statement.
- Q2: the nonterminal Keeper comes from the retained slot realization (`Nest.samples`). Its preservation is #317's open item.
- Not changed, since it is outside the claim: `original-history-portfolio-attachment.tex:117-123`.

## Evidence

- Pinned source revision: `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`. Base `codex/existence-monograph` @ `dcbdcc82`.
- Commands actually run and results:

  - `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: 22 OK;
  - `git diff --check`: clean;
  - `latexmk -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode -outdir=<scratch> existence.tex`: exit 0, 1017 pp., no undefined references. The new pages, pp. 697–700, were rendered and inspected.
- Checks not performed and why: no Lean elaboration or axiom replay. The Mathlib sources are blocked in this sandbox, so the Lean correspondence (`Relay.Tones`, `Bandage.ravine`, `hearthstone`, `asideP`, `Stow.lean`, `BarCode.lean`, `Sonata.lean`) was checked by reading the text only. The note gives file:line references.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units: this is a new proposition, and no existing statement changed. The C12 ledger row E-record/R7 and the C02 (v) row can cite it, keeping (K), (S) and (M) as named inputs.
